capabilities: Capture daily check-ins in a right sidebar timeline
Attach images, files, and audio to entries
Link check-ins to notes, selections, and files
Embed filtered timelines via dayline code blocks
Maintain day-file properties for Properties and Bases
extras: Mobile support not fully verified; malformed entry metadata shows a warning banner instead of crashing; embedded tag filter supports one tag only; attachments are not deleted when entries are deleted.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated quick-capture surface for timestamped daily check-ins; capturing them means opening and editing daily note files manually.
summary: Sidebar timeline for short daily check-ins, stored locally as daily markdown files with searchable entries, attachments, and embeds.
